CustomField.formula:
IF ((G2Crowd__Account__r.CreatedDate - G2Crowd__First_Event_Time__c) > 0, /*check to see if D2subD1 is greater than zero*/
TEXT(FLOOR( (G2Crowd__Account__r.CreatedDate - G2Crowd__First_Event_Time__c))) & " days " & /*returns the number of days in D2subD1*/
TEXT(FLOOR( 24 * ((G2Crowd__Account__r.CreatedDate - G2Crowd__First_Event_Time__c) - FLOOR((G2Crowd__Account__r.CreatedDate - G2Crowd__First_Event_Time__c)) ))) & " hours " & /*returns the remaining number of hours in D2subD1*/
TEXT(ROUND(60 * (ROUND( 24 * ( (G2Crowd__Account__r.CreatedDate - G2Crowd__First_Event_Time__c) - FLOOR((G2Crowd__Account__r.CreatedDate - G2Crowd__First_Event_Time__c)) ),8) - FLOOR(ROUND(24 * ((G2Crowd__Account__r.CreatedDate - G2Crowd__First_Event_Time__c) - FLOOR((G2Crowd__Account__r.CreatedDate - G2Crowd__First_Event_Time__c)) ),8)) ),0)) & " mins" /*returns the remaining number of minutes in D2subD1*/
, "")
CustomField.label: Time Between First Visit
